_comment_modules: RESOLVED (2026-07-14): element-web's loader does `import(src)` with the raw config value, executed from a bundle chunk under webapp/bundles/<hash>/. A bare or './'-relative specifier therefore fails ('Failed to resolve module specifier'). On desktop the webapp is served at vector://vector/webapp/ (electron-main registerFileProtocol), so the module MUST be referenced by its fully-qualified vector:// URL — the same scheme element-web uses to import its own chunks.
